title: Desenvolvedor(a) Natural/Adabas
description:
Profissional com sólida experiência em Natural e Adabas , atuando no mapeamento, análise e interpretação de dados provenientes de soluções que serão descontinuadas. Será responsável por garantir o correto entendimento das estruturas de dados e das regras de exibição implementadas nas aplicações nativas, viabilizando a migração dos dados para uma nova estrutura , mantendo fidelidade ao comportamento atual do sistema.


Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar as bases de dados Adabas , incluindo estruturas de arquivos e descritores, com foco na extração e migração de dados.
  • Avaliar aplicações Natural com front-end nativo , identificando como os dados são transformados, consolidados e apresentados ao usuário.
  • Interpretar e documentar as regras de negócio implementadas no front , mesmo quando não explicitamente documentadas.
  • Traduzir as regras de exibição e transformação de dados para um formato compreensível e reutilizável na nova estrutura de dados .
  • Apoiar a definição do modelo de dados de destino , garantindo que os dados migrados reflitam corretamente a lógica atual de apresentação.
  • Atuar como elo entre as equipes técnicas, de dados e de arquitetura durante o processo de desligamento das soluções Natural/Adabas.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Forte domínio de Natural (batch e online) .
  • Experiência sólida com Adabas , incluindo leitura de estruturas, descritores e relacionamentos implícitos.
  • Conhecimento em controle de acesso e segurança em ambientes mainframe.
  • Capacidade avançada de leitura, análise e entendimento de código legado Natural .
  • Vivência com processos de extração, transformação e migração de dados .
  • Noções de modelagem de dados para ambientes modernos (relacional, analítico ou outro destino definido).


Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Forte capacidade analítica para entender sistemas complexos e regras embutidas no código.
  • Facilidade em traduzir lógica técnica de front-end em regras de dados .
  • Comunicação clara para interação com times de dados, arquitetura e negócio.
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes, essenciais para garantir consistência na migração.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em projetos de desligamento (decommissioning) de sistemas Natural/Adabas.
  • Participação em iniciativas de modernização ou substituição de plataformas legadas .
  • Experiência em documentação de regras de negócio a partir de código-fonte.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: SAP Signavio Consultant
description:
SAP Signavio Consultant – Remote

Location : LATAM

Type : Contract


Job Description

We are seeking a SAP Signavio Consultant to join our team supporting process discovery, modeling, and process intelligence using SAP Signavio tools. This position is remote from Latin America and requires working in collaboration with US‑based functional and business teams (US time zones).


Responsibilities

  • Lead process discovery and modeling using SAP Signavio across core ERP domains (O2C, P2P, R2R, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain).
  • Support life sciences‑specific process mapping.
  • Deploy and manage SAP Signavio solutions (Process Manager, Collaboration Hub, Process Intelligence).
  • Analyze process mining data and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Collaborate effectively with US teams and business stakeholders.


Required Skills

  • 4–8 years’ experience in business process management, including 2–3 years with SAP Signavio.
  • Strong understanding of life sciences operational and compliance processes.
  • Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA or ECC ERP processes.
  • Excellent English communication skills and experience working with US teams.
  • Ability to work independently in a distributed nearshore setup.


Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP Signavio certifications.
  • Experience in pharma, biotech, or medical devices.
  • Knowledge of SAP Activate or other business transformation methodologies.


Background Checks

Full background check, employment history, education verification for the last 7 years, and a mandatory 10‑panel drug test for selected candidates.


Interested? Apply here or reach out directly to start a conversation at

title: Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Planejar, desenvolver, treinar, avaliar e monitorar modelos de Machine Learning, utilizando abordagens clássicas, NLP/NLI e LLMs;
  • Conduzir experimentações, provas de conceito (PoCs) e iniciativas de Discovery que apoiem a tomada de decisão e a automação de processos;
  • Explorar e analisar dados de negócio, realizando análises diagnósticas, preditivas e prescritivas;
  • Avaliar, estimar e acompanhar custos de implementação e operação em escala das soluções propostas;
  • Criar relatórios, dashboards e apresentações para comunicar resultados, insights e impactos dos projetos;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas de negócio e tecnologia, alinhando expectativas e defendendo boas práticas técnicas;
  • Propor inovações, apoiar decisões técnicas e contribuir para a evolução contínua das soluções de dados e IA.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Python avançado, com experiência em bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Pydantic, PyTorch e TensorFlow;
  • SQL intermediário a avançado, com atuação em bancos de dados relacionais;
  • Experiência com Databricks;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Machine Learning, incluindo técnicas de regressão, classificação, clustering e NLP;
  • Experiência com Large Language Models (LLMs), incluindo BERT, ASR, RAG, fine-tuning e modelos generativos.



Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com frameworks e APIs de ML e GenAI, como HuggingFace, LangChain, Azure OpenAI, DSPy, LangGraph, Vertex AI.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role: Senior .NET engineer

Location : Remote

Job Overview

1.8-12+ years of experience developing software & systems for medium to large business environments

Strong experience in one or more programming languages, technologies and software platforms, such as C#, JavaScript, MS-SQL Server, Sybase, Angular/REACT.

2.At least 5+ year’s hands-on experience with one of the programming languages (e.g. C# using .NET Core)

3.Excellent problem solving and communication skills

4.Familiarity with multi-threading

5.Strong experience with good design principles (design patterns, cohesion/coupling, S.O.L.I.D.)

6.Experience with Services Oriented Architecture and RESTful services development

7.Hands on experience with microservices

8.Experience with writing clean and maintainable code using engineering best practices (unit testing using xUnit/nUnit, TDD, continuous integration and deployment (teamcity/octopus), automation, refactoring, version controlling etc.)

9.Strong experience working with other developers, quality engineers (QE), ops engineers and support engineers to ensure smooth deployment, continual operation and passion for developing good software.

10.Experience participating in design discussions with both technical and non-technical audiences.

11.Experience mentoring and coaching more-junior developers

12.Experience documenting business solution in technical documents and diagrams

13.Familiarity or experience with Agile engineering practices.

14.Hands on experience in Containerization of application. (Docker/Rancher/ Kubernetes) .

15.Hands on experience in AI Tools (like GitHub Copilot).”

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Data Science / Machine Learning


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência com dados não estruturados e uso de dashboards para visualização e análise.

title: Full Stack Engineer  (Vue.js / Angular / C#)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience with Vue.js, React, or Angular, and 5+ years of C# software development experience, to join the software engineering team for our U.S. client. This key individual should have experience making decisions, leading a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a minor, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.


The industry-leading client provides business automation and enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.


Responsibilities

  • Coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contribute to team meetings; and troubleshoot development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Support and develop other developers, providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Define web architectures and solutions from business requirements, produce estimates and timelines, and manage delivery against those plans
  • Exhibit excellent communication skills and engage in technical discussions with peers, becoming a trusted technical advisor
  • Work with others to ensure adherence to code standards and best practices
  • Produce reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implement low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications
  • Implement secure by design standards, including data protection
  • Integration of data storage solutions
  • Ensure application performance, quality, and responsiveness
  • Collaborate with a team to define, design, and ship new features
  • Identify and correct bottlenecks as well as fix bugs


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 3+ years of Vue.js OR React.js and Angular experience
  • 5+ years of C# experience
  • Experience with defining service architectures and solutions from business requirements, producing estimates, and managing delivery against those timelines
  • Experience with SQL Server and NoSQL, such as MongoDB
  • Supports and develops other developers by providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage in technical discussions with peers and become a trusted technical advisor. Work with others to ensure code standards and best practices are followed
  • Experience writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implementation of low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications and services
  • Ability to coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contributing to team meetings; troubleshooting development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Strong proficiency working in a containerized deployment environment
  • Experience writing well-formed RESTful APIs


Desired Experience

  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry applications
  • Experience leading a small to medium-sized team, with assistance from outside parties
  • Understanding the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds
  • User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning
  • Knack for benchmarking and optimization
  • Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system
  • Understanding fundamental design principles behind a scalable application
  • Implementing automated testing platforms and unit tests
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools such as GitHub


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. title: Java Backend Developer Tech Lead
description:
Java Backend Developer Tech Lead


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary


As a Java Tech Lead, you will make a significant contribution to the software development, maintenance and performance improvement. You'll be is involved in every stage of the digital product development lifecycle, from planning and architecture to release, distribution, and quality assurance.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Acts as the primary technical point of contact for the team towards the client;
  • Work in a dynamic team to provide solutions with Java and NodeJS applications;
  • Lead technical discussions with the team;
  • Ensure the team is operating efficiently in the technical activities;
  • Participate in the complete cycle of development from design, development, testing and deployment;
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches;
  • Ensures the team adheres to timelines, quality standards and best practices;
  • Ensure the project quality;
  • Help to unblock the other team members;
  • Provide technical mentorship to the team;
  • Work with the project manager to plan sprints and deliverables.

Essential Skills


  • Hands-on object oriented programming experience in Java;
  • Hands-on object oriented experience in Javascript/NodeJS;
  • Experience with AngularJS;
  • Experience in database development, both SQL and NoSQL: development, maintenance, analysis;
  • Experience developing Restful APIs;
  • Experience working in agile teams;
  • Experience with code versioning with Git;
  • Experience in AWS cloud services.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Development of secure web applications;
  • Experience with modeling, producing and consuming web services based APIs (RESTful or SOAP based);
  • Experience with Jenkins;
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence;
  • Experience with Gitlab Automation;
  • Experience with Apache Camel.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Java Backend Developer Tech Lead
description:
Java Backend Developer Tech Lead


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary


As a Java Tech Lead, you will make a significant contribution to the software development, maintenance and performance improvement. You'll be is involved in every stage of the digital product development lifecycle, from planning and architecture to release, distribution, and quality assurance.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Acts as the primary technical point of contact for the team towards the client;
  • Work in a dynamic team to provide solutions with Java and NodeJS applications;

title: VMware/Broadcom VCI Instructor Japanese speaker
description:
Company Description

Go is a global platform connecting world-class technology training talent with those who need it most. By providing real-time access to top tech trainers across the globe, Go empowers leading cloud companies, technology resellers, and training providers to grow and thrive. The platform ensures effective learning and development, supporting organizations in their pursuit of technology excellence.


Role Description

This is a contract-based remote role for a VMware/Broadcom VCI Instructor who is fluent in Japanese. The instructor will deliver official VMware/Broadcom training to students and professionals in a virtual & live environment. Responsibilities include preparing training materials, facilitating engaging learning sessions, assessing participant progress, and providing feedback to support skill development. Effective communication and teaching techniques are essential for ensuring a high-quality learning experience.


Qualifications


  • It is mandatory that you must hold a valid  VMware Certified Professional (VCP)  certification.
  • Proficiency in Japanese with strong communication skills and the ability to engage learners effectively
  • Solid understanding of course content structure
  • Proven experience or certification in VMware and/or Broadcom training programs
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and adapt to different learning styles
  • Familiarity with virtual training tools and platforms
  • Relevant teaching/training certification(s) is a plus
  • It is highly desirable that you have already passed the VMware Instructor Certification Workshop (ICW). This 5-day workshop, however we will provide all necessary training to become a VCI.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP Full Stack - PL/SR
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Buscamos um(a) profissional SAP FullStack (Pleno ou Sênior) para atuar em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, com foco em desenvolvimento moderno utilizando o modelo RAP e aplicações Fiori. A posição envolve atuação ponta a ponta, desde a camada de dados e serviços até a interface, colaborando com arquitetos e consultores funcionais em times ágeis ou híbridos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver soluções SAP FullStack no ambiente S/4HANA.
  • Implementar serviços utilizando o modelo RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Criar e manter CDS Views (projection, exposure e behavior) e Behavior Definitions.
  • Desenvolver Service Definitions e Service Bindings com exposição via OData V4.
  • Construir aplicações com Fiori Elements.
  • Atuar com ABAP OO seguindo boas práticas de Clean Code e qualidade de código.
  • Realizar revisões de código e aplicar padrões de qualidade e sustentabilidade técnica.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, consultores funcionais e times ágeis.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com SAP S/4HANA.
  • Domínio do modelo RAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ABAP Orientado a Objetos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuação em times ágeis ou híbridos.
  • Mentalidade orientada a Clean Code, qualidade e manutenção evolutiva.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Participação em pelo menos uma implementação greenfield de SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ATC, SCI ou outras ferramentas de qualidade de código.
  • Certificações SAP.
  • Inglês intermediário/ avançado.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto no Brasil

Viagens pontoais (2-3 vezes ao ano)


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Entrepreneur and SMEs (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with entrepreneurs, founders, and executives of startups, scale-ups, and small to medium enterprises (10-50 employee).



Qualifications:

  • The purpose of this study is to gain an understanding of the global awareness of city’s attractiveness in trade, investment and partnership. I believe your opinions and expertise would be valuable for our study and I wonder if you’re interested in taking part.
  • Job titles: Founder, Co-founder, C-suite Executive, Partner, Director, Vice President, General Manager, Head of Department.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 30-minute interview conducted via MS Teams and the interview can be held in either English or Portuguese.
  • Please note that, before the final interview, there'll be a 10-minute quick online screener to share more details on the research and to check that this is relevant to you.


Compensation package - BRL 945 for a 30-minute online interview.

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Software Engineer UX (C# / XAML)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer, UX, with 5+ years of professional experience to join our U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in C#, XAML, WinForms, and MAUI.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with a small team in an agile environment to improve our clients' UI experiences by developing new functionality and maintaining existing client applications. You must have experience with UI design, development, and debugging.

Protecting over 17,000 facilities in 80 countries across six continents, our client is a global leader in providing comprehensive visibility into critical infrastructure management, enabling swift problem resolution, waste reduction, and cost efficiencies while significantly elevating operational performance. The company's suite of software solutions enables customers to quickly identify and remediate critical plant issues, elevate plant operational performance, and ultimately drive safer, more efficient, always-on operations.


Responsibilities

  • Seek input from stakeholders, share and review UI mockups, synthesize feedback on usability, carefully consider localization, and empower other team members to create learning materials for the new UI
  • Develop view models, views, custom controls, and UI patterns in C# and XAML in both MAUI and WPF
  • Transform existing WinForms dialogs into reimagined and improved WPF implementations
  • Take ownership of solving interesting problems, architect new objects, improve the solutions of other team members, and maintain the solution as it is deployed globally


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments using C# and XAML
  • Strong proficiency in WinForms and MAUI
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization
  • Experience working collaboratively with design and back-end teams
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with third-party controls, such as Telerik and ComponentOne
  • Experience with web development, such as Angular and ASP.NET
  • Familiar with Microsoft SQL Server and Entity Framework

title: Senior Software Engineer UX (C# / XAML)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer, UX, with 5+ years of professional experience to join our U.S. client. Candidates must have a strong background in C#, XAML, WinForms, and MAUI.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with a small team in an agile environment to improve our clients' UI experiences by developing new functionality and maintaining existing client applications. You must have experience with UI design, development, and debugging.

Protecting over 17,000 facilities in 80 countries across six continents, our client is a global leader in providing comprehensive visibility into critical infrastructure management, enabling swift problem resolution, waste reduction, and cost efficiencies while significantly elevating operational performance. The company's suite of software solutions enables customers to quickly identify and remediate critical plant issues, elevate plant operational performance, and ultimately drive safer, more efficient, always-on operations.


Responsibilities

  • Seek input from stakeholders, share and review UI mockups, synthesize feedback on usability, carefully consider localization, and empower other team members to create learning materials for the new UI
  • Develop view models, views, custom controls, and UI patterns in C# and XAML in both MAUI and WPF
  • Transform existing WinForms dialogs into reimagined and improved WPF implementations
  • Take ownership of solving interesting problems, architect new objects, improve the solutions of other team members, and maintain the solution as it is deployed globally


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments using C# and XAML
  • Strong proficiency in WinForms and MAUI
  • Ability to contribute across the stack from back-end logic and data modeling to key front-end integrations
  • Strong understanding of component-based architecture, state management, responsive design, and performance optimization

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams

title: Banco de Talentos: Consultor de Implementação ITSM
description:
Sobre a Bravo Solutions


A Bravo Solutions é uma empresa inovadora especializada em soluções de software que visam transformar a experiência do cliente. Nossa missão é fornecer ferramentas tecnológicas de ponta que permitam aos nossos clientes otimizar seus processos e alcançar resultados excepcionais.

Estamos buscando perfis para o nosso Banco de Talentos com foco em consultoria técnica. Este profissional será o responsável por dar vida às soluções, atuando tanto na configuração de novos projetos (implementação) quanto no atendimento especializado para garantir a continuidade e evolução das ferramentas nos nossos clientes.


⚠️ Atenção ao Perfil: Esta é uma posição de cunho técnico e operacional . Buscamos profissionais que gostam de configurar sistemas, desenhar fluxos lógicos e resolver problemas de software. Se o seu perfil é focado exclusivamente em Customer Success (CS) comercial, gestão de contas ou métricas de retenção, esta vaga não se adequa às suas atividades diárias.
O que você fará por aqui:

Buscamos um Consultor versátil para atuar em duas frentes principais:

  • Implementação e Projetos: Analisar os processos do cliente e realizar a configuração técnica (parametrização ) das ferramentas Freshworks e similares. Criar fluxos de automação, níveis de serviço (SLAs) e portais de autoatendimento.
  • Consultoria de Suporte: Atendimento especializado de tickets de média e alta complexidade, realizando diagnósticos de causa raiz e ajustes de configuração para garantir o sucesso da solução.
  • Treinamento e Capacitação: Conduzir sessões consultivas para ensinar usuários e administradores a utilizarem as funcionalidades técnicas configuradas.


O que buscamos (Requisitos):
  • Experiência Técnica: Vivência prévia com implementação de sistemas, suporte técnico especializado ou consultoria de software SaaS.
  • Lógica de Sistemas: Capacidade de traduzir processos de negócio em regras lógicas dentro do software (Ex: \"If/Then\" logic, automações e triggers).
  • Domínio de Ferramentas: Familiaridade com softwares de ITSM, Helpdesk ou CRM (Freshservice, Freshdesk, Jira Service Management ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em Processos: Fundamentos de ITIL , Gestão de Serviços ou Governança de TI.
  • Formação: Graduação concluída ou cursando em TI, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Administração de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.


Diferenciais:
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento em Scrum ou Kanban para organização de fluxos de trabalho e entregas.
  • Idioma: Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentações e interação com parceiros globais.


Informações Gerais:
  • Modelo de Contratação: Possibilidade de contratação via CLT ou PJ.


Por que entrar para o nosso banco?

  • Boa escrita e capacidade de formalização de informações.

title: Arquiteto(a) em Soluções SAP SuccessFactors BTP
description:
• Gerenciar todo o ciclo de vida das soluções propostas, desde o desenho e desenvolvimento até o acompanhamento da entrega.
  • Estimar custos e esforços para novas soluções e projetos complexos de implantação.
  • Demonstrar conhecimento avançado em SAP HCM SuccessFactors e domínio técnico de soluções BTP/SCPI (Integration Suite).
  • Desenvolver extensões no SAP BTP (CAP) utilizando Node.js aplicando boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Liderar a estratégia e execução de desenvolvimentos, garantindo aderência às melhores práticas (Clean Core, Microserviços, arquitetura orientada a APIs).
  • Implementar integrações standard do SAP SuccessFactors (BIB, Infoporter, Point-to-Point, MDI, IDoc, ALE).
  • Construir integrações complexas com SAP Integration Suite, ABAP, APIs REST/OData, SAP Gateway, OAuth 2.0, SAML e Webservices SOAP.
  • Desenvolver APIs customizadas para SAP ECP e S/4HANA, garantindo segurança e performance.
  • Garantir segurança, escalabilidade e governança das integrações, incluindo monitoramento e troubleshooting.
  • Definir padrões técnicos para extensões e integrações, promovendo arquitetura sustentável e alinhada às estratégias corporativas.


Requisitos :

  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Administração, ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência como Arquiteto SAP SuccessFactors em projetos de implementação.
  • Experiência na implementação de integrações standard (BIB, Point-to-Point, Infoporter, MDI, ALE, IDoc).
  • Conhecimento avançado em SAP HCM SuccessFactors, SAP Integration Suite, ABAP HCM, APIs REST/OData, SAP Gateway e SAP BTP.
  • Proficiência em desenvolvimento no SAP BTP (CAP) com Node.js.
  • Experiência com monitoramento e troubleshooting (SAP Cloud Integration Monitor).
  • Certificações SAP BTP, SuccessFactors ou TOGAF serão consideradas diferenciais.

Desejável:

  • Conhecimento em SAP PI/PO, SAP ALM, SAP Fiori e práticas de governança de APIs.
  • Experiência com CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins, Cloud Foundry).
  • Familiaridade com LGPD/GDPR e segurança de dados.
  • Inglês avançado.

title: Desenvolvedor SAP Commerce Cloud - Hybris
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações baseadas em SAP Commerce Cloud, incluindo customizações de backoffice, storefront e APIs.

  • Experiência em SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris).

  • Uso de Git
  • Experiência com processos ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


Diferenciais

  • Certificação SAP Commerce Cloud Developer.
  • Conhecimento em SAP Customer Data Cloud e SAP Sales/Service Cloud.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos omnichannel ou B2B/B2C

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Customer Success (RH)
description:
Responsável por contribuir com o Sucesso do Cliente e os interesses do negócio com a solução e serviços adquiridos, para entregar uma melhor experiência de uso em todas as etapas da jornada na TOTVS.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Otimizar a experiência do cliente, ampliando a satisfação em cada ponto da Jornada, por meio do
  • acompanhamento de indicadores de sucesso e satisfação;
  • Coordenar a equipe sob sua responsabilidade para mobilizar e desdobrar a atuação dos times correlacionados, realizando a gestão no que tange a controle de ponto, férias, ausências, 1:1, feedbacks, dailys e ações de gestão de pessoas;
  • Participar de Reuniões de alinhamento entre as áreas (juntos aos demais coordenadores) para ajustar ou alinhar processos, priorizando em cenário de múltiplas demandas junto a liderança do time, conciliando as diferenças de opinião e estilos de forma positiva, com a escuta ativa em busca da melhor solução;
  • Dar visibilidade dos resultados da área, integrando os diversos departamentos da empresa para que haja o constante cumprimento de promessas feitas para o cliente, além de dar visibilidade dos resultados da área;
  • Atrair, desenvolver e inspirar os melhores TOTVERS dedicando tempo de qualidade a seu time;
  • Garantir a execução dos processos existentes, revisar, criar processos e/ou metodologias utilizados pela área, buscando a simplificação das atividades e ganho de eficiência;
  • Mobilizar as equipes TOTVS para que as oportunidades de melhoria e/ou eventuais problemas sejam endereçados e executados, por meio do compartilhamento de feedbacks de seus clientes com os times;
  • Ser a voz do cliente (VoC) nas reuniões/interações com outros times (produto, suporte, vendas,
  • implantação), trazendo a visão dos clientes nas estratégias das áreas.
  • Direcionar o líder na capacitação do time compartilhando boas práticas de atuação de CS, assim como contribuir com a visão de negócio e de mercado.
  • Orquestrar ações de organização, carteiras e segmentação dos clientes para acompanhamento dos Agentes de Sucesso.;
  • Estruturar, revisar e publicar as pesquisas de NPS para os grupos de trabalho envolvidos na gestão dos promotores, neutros e detratores por linha de produto;
  • Efetuar acompanhamento das EBRs, revisando e validando conteúdo, de forma a estabelecer
  • conjuntamente com o Agente de Sucesso, um Plano de Ação eventualmente definido para determinado cliente.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Formação: Superior completo. Desejável pós-graduação, especialização, MBA ou capacitação complementar na área de relacionamento com o cliente.

Conhecimentos específicos:

  • Marketing Digital - conceitual;
  • Familiaridade com o mercado de tecnologia, startups e/ou SaaS;
  • Técnicas de Negociação
  • Resolução de Problemas
  • Excel e Power Point - nível avançado
  • ITIL, Metodologias Ágeis, Design Thinking ou Gestão de Processos de Negócios - desejável
  • Regras de Negócio de acordo com o segmento de atuação (desejável);

Gestão de Pessoas;

  • Indicadores de CS e CX - nível avançado.

Idiomas:

  • Desejável inglês - nível intermediário


Benefícios

  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Bicicletário;
  • Vestiário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;
  • Gympass.

title: English EdEnglish Educators Wanted – Teach from Home! [T] Educators Wanted – Teach from Home!
description:
Job description


Are you a dedicated English teacher with a passion for education and professional growth?

Join our state-of-the-art online platform and enjoy unique benefits like flexible hours and remote work.


We're seeking committed teachers to make a lasting impact on students worldwide.


Why You'll Love Working with us:


  • Work from Home: Enjoy the convenience and comfort of teaching from your own home.
  • Flexible Hours: Customize your schedule to fit your lifestyle.
  • Professional Development: Access opportunities for advancement and continuous professional growth.
  • Supportive Community: Join a network of like-minded educators dedicated to excellence.
  • Dedicated Portal: You will have your own state-of-the-art, proprietary management system for teaching students online.

    • What We're Looking For:


    • Passion for Education: Enthusiastic and dedicated to teaching.
    • Commitment to Career: Long-term dedication to the teaching profession.
    • Continuous Professional Development (CPD): History of additional qualifications, courses, seminars, and

    certifications (e.g., IELTS/Cambridge Examiner Certification, YL Extensions).

    • Advanced ESL Qualifications: Level 5 equivalent or higher (CELTA, TKT, DipTESOL, PGCE, MEd, PHDEd).

    • Bilingual Teacher requirements


    • Bachelor’s Degree or higher
    • English teaching certificate (TESOL/TEFL/TESL – preferred CELTA/DELTA)
    • 2+ years ESL teaching experience

    • Language


    • If English native - Additional language level: Intermediate (CEFR B1+)
    • If additional language native - English Level: Proficient (CEFR C2)


    Additional Languages


    • Chinese (Upper Intermediate CEFR B2)
    • Japanese (Upper Intermediate CEFR B2)
    • Portuguese (CEFR C1)
    • Turkish (CEFR C1)
    • French (CEFR C1)
    • Spanish (CEFR C1)
    • Vietnamese (CEFR C1)
    • Bahasa Indonesia (CEFR C1)
    • Arabic (CEFR C1)
    • Korean (Upper Intermediate CEFR B2)
    • Thai (CEFR C1)
    • Urdu (CEFR C1)

title: Bilingual Civil Engineer (Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems)
description:
The Company

Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.

Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, SysPro, D365 & Salesforce.

One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / GenAI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.


We are seeking a multiple Civil Engineers with emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.

English language proficiency is mandatory.


These are remote roles.


This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

ROLES:

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)


Executive Summary

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
  • Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
  • Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
  • Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
  • The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
  • Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
  • Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
  • Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
  • Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
  • Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leads


Experience level

  • Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
  • Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

title: Technical Support Consultant L3
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Technical Support Consultant with 3 to 5 years of software support experience to join the client operations team of our U.S. client. You will play a critical role in ensuring our client's software lives up to its world-class reputation.

Our client provides a cloud-based, ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver Level 3 customer support for our client's industry-leading software products
  • Triage reported, end-user customer incidents
  • Work technical issues and support the direct client feedback loop process
  • Help secure existing revenue by means of customer retention
  • Provide incident queue management
  • Utilize troubleshooting skills
  • Help manage complex issues and drive escalations to resolution
  • Build and demonstrate cross-application knowledge among the client's core application modules
  • Push the client's software to the limit, making sure it is efficient, intuitive, and best-in-class
  • Gain experience in the oil and gas industry; including economic, accounting, and finance knowledge


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • 3 to 5 years of Level 3 software support experience
  • Basic to intermediate SQL skills
  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite
  • A drive to continue learning in the energy business and the client's software
  • Advanced problem-solving skills
  • Ability to triage and actively manage a support queue
  • Innate passion for customer service
  • Dependability and ability to manage as well as prioritize concurrent tasks
  • Must be available for an on-call rotation
  • Ability to work U.S. CST business hours
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience creating manuals, training documentation, and interactive training materials for software applications
  • Experience providing software support and troubleshooting for SaaS applications
  • Experience in reproducing issues in a test environment prior to production deployment
  • Experience in the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Business Leaders (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with leaders and senior professionals —such as CEO, CFO, Director, VP, Department Head and Senior Manager .



Qualifications:

  • The purpose of this study is to gain an understanding of the global awareness of city’s attractiveness in trade, investment and partnership. I believe your opinions and expertise would be valuable for our study and I wonder if you’re interested in taking part.
  • Job titles: C-suite Executive, Partner, Director, Vice President, Head of Department and Senior Manager.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 30-minute interview conducted via MS Teams and the interview can be held in either English or Portuguese.
  • Please note that, before the final interview, there'll be a 10-minute quick online screener to share more details on the research and to check that this is relevant to you.


Compensation package - BRL 790 for a 30-minute online interview.

o Experience in Agile development methodology and Scrum

o Identify and encourage areas for growth and improvement within the team.

title: Strategic Operations Project Coordinator
description:
Strategic Operations Project Coordinator


We are currently hiring for a division which focuses on providing services to immigration law firms across the United States.


The Strategic Operations Project Coordinator will serve as a key support resource to operational leadership, combining elements of project coordination, business analysis, and administrative management. This role is responsible for managing small-to-medium projects, conducting research and analysis, building documentation, performing system testing, and offloading administrative tasks from senior leaders to improve organizational efficiency. The ideal candidate will be highly proficient in AI tools and demonstrate strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities

-Project Management

  • Manage and coordinate small-to-medium projects from initiation through completion.
  • Develop project timelines, track milestones, and ensure deliverables are met on schedule.
  • Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders and communicate project status to leadership.
  • Identify and escalate project risks or blockers appropriately.


-Operational Support

  • Offload administrative and analytical tasks from operational leaders including report generation, data compilation, and meeting preparation.
  • Conduct research on industry trends, competitive intelligence, process improvements, and business opportunities.
  • Assist in the preparation of presentations, briefing materials, and strategic documents.
  • Support special initiatives and ad-hoc requests from leadership.


-Analysis and Reporting

  • Perform light data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
  • Create and maintain operational reports and dashboards for leadership review.
  • Analyze business processes and recommend efficiency improvements.
  • Synthesize complex information into clear, actionable summaries.


-Documentation and System Testing

  • Build and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and training materials.
  • Conduct system testing for new features, integrations, or process changes.
  • Document test results, identify issues, and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution.
  • Ensure documentation is accurate, current, and accessible to appropriate stakeholders.


-AI Tool Utilization

  • Leverage AI tools (Claude, etc.) to enhance productivity and output quality.
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI capabilities to operational challenges.
  • Stay current on AI tool developments and best practices.


Qualification

-Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field
  • 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination, business analysis, or administrative support roles
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) in professional contexts
  • Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret data and identify insights
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Self-motivated with ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to take initiative


-Preferred:

  • Familiarity with project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.)
  • Experience with business intelligence or data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
  • Experience with SharePoint, Power Automate, or other Microsoft 365 automation tools
  • Project management certification (PMP, CAPM) or similar credentials

title: Account Manager
description:
Our client, an iGaming Game provider is seeking an experienced Account Manager based in LATAM, fluent in both Portuguese and English, with a strong background in the iGaming or gambling industry.


This role is ideal for a professional who is passionate about building long-term partner relationships, driving customer engagement, and working closely with internal and external stakeholders. The Account Manager will play a key role in managing client interactions, monitoring partner performance, supporting customer retention, and ensuring seamless day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate is highly organized, results-driven, and open to traveling for business trips and industry events.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the main point of contact for partners by providing ongoing support, answering queries, and resolving account-related issues. Assist with technical inquiries, communicate new features and promotions, and help resolve operational challenges.
  • Drive the successful launch of new game titles by actively promoting upcoming releases and securing optimal placement within partners’ casino lobbies.
  • Monitor partner activity on the platform by analyzing player numbers, betting volumes, gameplay frequency, and performance trends, identifying opportunities for growth or additional support.
  • Focus on sales growth and customer retention through personalized commercial offers, promotional campaigns, and special initiatives.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams including marketing, design, finance, integration management, and technical support to ensure smooth partner operations.
  • Represent the company and present products and services during business trips, conferences, and networking events.


Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience as an Account Manager within the iGaming or gambling industry (experience with casino game providers is an advantage).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain trusted partnerships.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and results-focused.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Full professional fluency in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken.
  • Willingness to travel for business meetings and industry events.
  • Proficiency with digital tools and platforms such as HubSpot, Jira, and Confluence.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join the Prosigliere team.


Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Engineer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. This role requires a deep understanding of data warehousing principles, ETL processes, and database management, with a strong focus on ensuring data quality, accessibility, and performance to support our analytical and reporting needs. You will play a critical role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, empowering our data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient ETL/ELT pipelines using various data integration techniques to ingest, transform, and load data from diverse sources into our data warehouse.
  • Manage and optimize data models and structures within Snowflake, ensuring strategic organization for performance, cost-efficiency, and ease of consumption by analytics and reporting tools.
  • Administer and optimize PostgreSQL databases, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Develop, monitor, and troubleshoot data workflows and orchestrations using Apache Airflow to ensure timely and reliable data delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency by implementing robust data validation, cleansing, and monitoring processes.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing Tableau reports, and develop new, insightful dashboards and visualizations to meet business needs.
  • Implement and maintain data governance best practices, including data security, privacy, and compliance.
  • Participate in code reviews, contribute to architectural discussions, and promote best practices in data engineering.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform and processes.


Technology Requirements

  • Databases: Strong expertise in PostgreSQL and extensive experience with Snowflake data warehousing.
  • Orchestration: Proficient in using Apache Airflow for workflow management and scheduling.
  • ETL/ELT: Proven experience in designing and implementing efficient ETL/ELT processes.
  • Business Intelligence: Hands-on experience with Tableau for report troubleshooting and development.
  • Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, scripting, and automation.
  • Cloud Platforms: Experience with at least one major cloud provider (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and their data-related services (e.g., S3, EC2, Azure Data Lake Storage, Google Cloud Storage, BigQuery).
  • Data Concepts: Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, data lakes, and data marts.
  • Version Control: Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • SQL: Advanced SQL writing and optimization skills.
  • Big Data Technologies (Plus): Familiarity with big data technologies like Spark, Kafka, or similar is a plus.


Profile Requirements

  • Ability to learn quickly and work independently.
  • Strong project management and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with others.

title: TIBCO EBX Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Java development, ideally applied within TIBCO EBX extensions or customizations;
  • Hands‑on experience developing on TIBCO EBX (data modeling, workflows, services, UI configuration, data quality rules);
  • Understanding of Master Data Management (MDM) processes and governance, especially in EBX contexts;
  • Strong understanding of Java design patterns, MVC, and Java data structures, supporting EBX development best practices;
  • English B2 and Portuguese native;
  • Must relocate to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: relocation to Portugal and in here will be 2x on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send apply!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: IBM TM1 / Planning Analytics Consultants - WORKING INTO THE US & CANADA
description:
IBM PLANNING ANALYTICS SENIOR TM1 CONSULTANTS


FANTASTIC NEW JOB BASED IN BRAZIL TO WORK INTO CLIENTS IN THE US & CANADA TORONTO!!


CONTRACT OR PERMANENT -


In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing financial planning solutions using IBM Planning Analytics to achieve project success as agreed with customers; deliver technical, functional, and business outcomes of a project and maintaining high standards of professional communication.


Accountabilities include, but are not limited to:


  • Analysis and evaluation of business requirements through a structured methodical approach
  • Define the solution scope, time, cost and risk by translating business requirements into a set of functional and non-functional deliverables.
  • Estimate and plan project deliverables and success criteria
  • Identify project Risks and Assumptions
  • Communicate with stakeholders, business and technical project teams to ensure the roles and responsibilities for the solution deliver are understood
  • Implementation of financial planning solutions in IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 as designed in the solution scope definition
  • Identify all potential Change Requests and work with designated Principal Consultant/ Project Manager on these variations
  • Participate in Post Implementation Review and assume ownership of any actions


Desired Skills and Experience


Essential


  • Greater than 5 years’ experience in delivering financial planning applications (IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 will be highly valued);
  • Minimum education level of Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a relevant subject – Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, Finance & Accounting;
  • Proven project experience delivering financial planning solutions covering most phases of the project lifecycle including scoping, requirements gathering, design, development, testing and deployment while using project management methodologies;
  • In-depth knowledge and senior level expertise in IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 including cube design, turbo integrator processes & rule engine; IBM Cognos TM1 Certified Developer would be an added advantage;
  • A genuine talent for grasping complex business problems and engineering effective solutions;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills


Highly Regarded


  • Background in finance and understanding of financial processes such as budgeting & forecasting or supply chain roles is desirable;
  • Well developed skills/ability researching, designing and implementing customer solutions and programs;
  • Strong relationship management;
  • Ability to identify opportunities and taking action to help achieve business goals;
  • Ability to identify process improvement opportunities;
  • Team player with a professional, pro-active approach
  • Citizenship is highly regarded but not essential.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer

£70,000 - £90,000

Remote - Brazil (You will need to work UK time zone)


You already know how to build software that works.


What you might be missing is the chance to build something that matters, where the details count and the users notice when you get it right.


This role is for an engineer who cares how things look, how they behave, and how they hold up when real money and real users are involved.


Why you’ll love it here:

  • You’ll own real parts of the product, not just tickets
  • The UI has to be precise and trusted, not “close enough”
  • You’ll work across the full stack with real influence over decisions
  • The product sits between traditional finance expectations and onchain systems
  • You’ll build for institutional and high net worth users who demand clarity and reliability


Who this isn’t for:

This isn’t a role for someone who wants a narrow remit, loose UI standards, or to ship features without thinking end to end.


If you prefer clear tickets, minimal ownership, or letting AI do the thinking for you, this will feel uncomfortable.


Day to day:

You’ll be building and refining a production platform used to manage onchain assets.


That means turning product direction and designs into polished, accurate UI, then wiring it properly into APIs, databases, and background workflows.


The split is genuinely full stack. You’ll spend meaningful time on the frontend, but you’re also expected to contribute confidently on the backend so features are built end to end, not in isolation.


Performance, maintainability, and correctness matter because this platform is already live and evolving.


The Business:

The business is a FinTech fund building onchain banking infrastructure for institutional capital.

It operates where stablecoins, DeFi lending, automation, and risk management meet.


The focus is usability and trust, bringing institutional-grade expectations into onchain finance, with active engagement from major financial institutions.


Requirements:

  • Strong full stack experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript
  • Proven ability to ship precise, production-quality UI
  • Solid SQL knowledge with Postgres and an ORM such as Prisma
  • Experience designing APIs and backend workflows, including orchestration tools like Temporal
  • Understanding of ERC-4626 and DeFi lending markets such as Aave or Morpho
  • Confident, structured use of LLM tools like Cursor or Claude Code
  • FinTech experience preferred
  • Able to travel freely across Europe


If you want ownership, technical breadth, and the chance to build a mature system people genuinely rely on, this is worth a conversation.

It operates where stablecoins, DeFi lending, automation, and risk management meet.


The focus is usability and trust, bringing institutional-grade expectations into onchain finance, with active engagement from major financial institutions.

  • Strong full stack experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript
  • Proven ability to ship precise, production-quality UI
  • Solid SQL knowledge with Postgres and an ORM such as Prisma
  • Experience designing APIs and backend workflows, including orchestration tools like Temporal
  • Understanding of ERC-4626 and DeFi lending markets such as Aave or Morpho
  • Confident, structured use of LLM tools like Cursor or Claude Code
  • FinTech experience preferred
  • Able to travel freely across Europe


If you want ownership, technical breadth, and the chance to build a mature system people genuinely rely on, this is worth a conversation.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer

£70,000 - £90,000

Remote - Brazil (You will need to work UK time zone)


You already know how to build software that works.


What you might be missing is the chance to build something that matters, where the details count and the users notice when you get it right.


This role is for an engineer who cares how things look, how they behave, and how they hold up when real money and real users are involved.


Why you’ll love it here:

  • You’ll own real parts of the product, not just tickets
  • The UI has to be precise and trusted, not “close enough”
  • You’ll work across the full stack with real influence over decisions
  • The product sits between traditional finance expectations and onchain systems
  • You’ll build for institutional and high net worth users who demand clarity and reliability


Who this isn’t for:

This isn’t a role for someone who wants a narrow remit, loose UI standards, or to ship features without thinking end to end.


If you prefer clear tickets, minimal ownership, or letting AI do the thinking for you, this will feel uncomfortable.


Day to day:

You’ll be building and refining a production platform used to manage onchain assets.


That means turning product direction and designs into polished, accurate UI, then wiring it properly into APIs, databases, and background workflows.


The split is genuinely full stack. You’ll spend meaningful time on the frontend, but you’re also expected to contribute confidently on the backend so features are built end to end, not in isolation.


Performance, maintainability, and correctness matter because this platform is already live and evolving.

title: Customer Success Executive
description:
A Vozis é uma empresa de automação por voz com inteligência artificial. Desenvolvemos agentes inteligentes capazes de realizar e atender chamadas telefônicas para empresas de diversos segmentos, automatizando operações e potencializando resultados.


# Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional de Customer Success para atuar como responsável direto pela gestão da nossa base de clientes , sendo o principal ponto de contato entre a Vozis e cada conta.


Essa pessoa será responsável por gerir o relacionamento com os clientes de ponta a ponta , garantindo adoção do produto, acompanhamento contínuo da performance dos agentes de voz, análise de métricas e chamadas, coleta de feedbacks e implementação de melhorias que assegurem satisfação, retenção e geração de valor.


Buscamos alguém com comunicação clara e proativa, forte capacidade analítica para transformar dados em ações práticas e organização para gerenciar múltiplos clientes simultaneamente , mantendo visão de resultado e prioridade.


# Requisitos

Valorizamos candidatos com perfil técnico . Nosso produto é tecnologia em sua essência: trabalhamos com agentes de IA, criação e estruturação de prompts, fluxos de dados e integrações com sistemas externos. Por isso, é essencial ter facilidade em lidar com tecnologia e interesse em evoluir constantemente nesse ambiente.

title: Systems Architect – Prediction Market
description:
About the Role

Forkast is a prediction market where crypto traders and gamers predict real-world events. Real-time, high-integrity infrastructure where every millisecond counts. We’re looking for a hands-on Systems Architect to take our trading engine from exceptional to elite.


The ideal candidate has scaled production-grade systems at serious volume. This isn’t a whiteboard-only position. This is a high-stakes engineering role at the intersection of finance, crypto, and frontier prediction market systems design.


You’ll be solving performance bottlenecks, owning major redesigns, and championing best practices in distributed computing.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead the evolution of our trading engine, scaling throughput, reliability, and latency.
  • Design and optimize the integration between off-chain matching engines and on-chain settlement (USDC on Arbitrum).
  • Apply industry-standard approaches to distributed systems design, ensuring consistency, fault tolerance, and correctness.
  • Establish and implement robust observability practices, including tracing, metrics, logging, and alerting.
  • Design and scale data storage systems, including database partitioning, sharding, and performance tuning.
  • Guide the team in implementing complex designs correctly through code reviews, technical direction, and hands-on collaboration.
  • Step in as a builder when needed: implement performance-critical components, optimize in-memory order books, and improve messaging and data pipelines.


What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience scaling high-throughput, low-latency trading systems or similar distributed platforms in production.
  • Deep understanding of trading engine architecture, including settlement, batching, state consistency, and failure modes.
  • Hands-on experience with system-level performance optimization and distributed systems.
  • Practical experience setting up and operating monitoring, tracing, and observability tools at scale.
  • Experience designing and scaling databases, including partitioning strategies and data access optimization.
  • Coding alongside the team. Hands-on contributions, not just oversight.
  • Ability to guide a team in adopting industry standards and implementing them consistently.


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with prediction markets, decentralized exchanges, or hybrid CeFi/DeFi systems.
  • Familiarity with cloud-scale infrastructure, production operations, and large-scale data storage.
  • Familiarity with trading agents using open agent platforms like OpenClaw


Why This Role

  • Directly influence the architecture and scalability of a high-performance trading platform.
  • Work hands-on with top-tier engineers on genuinely hard distributed systems problems.
  • Competitive compensation and equity for a role with real technical ownership and impact.

title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Buscar inspiração no mercado para trazer novas ideias que possam ser utilizadas para melhorar a plataforma de dados;
  • Atuar ativamente na detecção e na solução de problemas, oportunidades e melhorias relacionados à disciplina de dados na tecnologia;
  • Garantir que o time esteja alinhado com evolução da plataforma e todos entendam as motivações por trás delas;
  • Identificar e antecipar impactos das abordagens em outros produtos cross-squads;
  • Trazer a visão do todo, ao colaborar com o planejamento, acompanhamento e organização de uma dada iniciativa que visa onde outro analista, seja responsável, até a entrega de valor, ajudando a mapear os possíveis riscos e impactos;
  • Orientar, engajar e fomentar proativamente a cultura data driven em toda a Empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou área relacionada;
  • Python;
  • SQL;
  • Conceitos de administração de banco de dados;
  • Conceitos de DW;
  • Shell;
  • Alguma ferramenta/linguagem de IaC: terraform, ansible, puppet;
  • Conceitos de infraestrutura (rede, disco, cpu...);
  • Proficiência com containers (docker, kubernetes);
  • Conceitos de engenharia de software (protocolos de API, SoC, SOLID e etc);
  • Conceitos de sistemas com uso intensivo de dados: lakehouse, data lake, DW MPP;
  • Proficiência com ferramentas de processamento em streaming: kafka, spark, flink;
  • Conceitos de streaming de dados: hopping, session, tumbling;
  • Proficiência com bancos nosql: mongo, cassandra (scyllaDB), druid
  • Conceitos de arquiteturas de sistemas distribuidos: ring, master/worker;
  • Conceitos de machine learning: treino, serving, feature, reinforcement learning;
  • Proficiência com infraestrutura em cloud.
